crossRefs.note: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city, and told the chief priests all the things…
Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.

people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”
translations.bsb: “You have a guard,” Pilate said. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”
translations.kjv: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
translations.asv: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a guard: go, make it as sure as ye can.
